faqPreview.title: Common questions before you start
faqPreview.description: Short answers to the questions we hear most from businesses planning a digital project.

websiteCost.question: How much does a website cost?
websiteCost.answer: At Artecium, websites start at €750 (Essential). The Professional plan costs €1,500 and Business projects start at €2,500, depending on features.

includesSeo.question: Does the price include SEO?
includesSeo.answer: Plans include basic technical best practices. Ongoing SEO is a separate service, from €350 (Foundation) or on monthly plans.

addFeaturesLater.question: Can I add features later?
addFeaturesLater.answer: Yes. Many clients start with an essential website and evolve later — blog, SEO, automation or integrations.

portugal.question: Do you work with businesses in Portugal?
portugal.answer: Yes. We work with businesses in Portugal, with particular focus on Lisbon, Almada, Setúbal and Margem Sul.

seoOnly.question: Can I hire SEO only?
seoOnly.answer: Yes. SEO Foundation (€350) is an initial setup. For ongoing support, Growth (€500/month) and Advanced (€900/month) plans are available.

howToStart.question: How do I start a project?
howToStart.answer: Request a quote through the form. We'll review your project and suggest the most suitable solution and investment.

items.question: How much does a professional website cost?
items.answer: At Artecium, websites start at €750. The Website Professional is priced at €1,500 and Business projects start at €2,500, depending on functionality and requirements.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: Timelines depend on scope, number of pages, content and functionality. After discovery, we provide a clear estimate before moving forward.

items.question: Will the website be optimised for SEO?
items.answer: Yes. All websites include foundational technical SEO. Higher-tier plans also include on-page optimisation, conversion-focused structure and Google Search Console setup.

items.question: Can you integrate WhatsApp and forms?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate contact forms and WhatsApp into websites, according to the package and project goals.

items.question: Can you build custom functionality?
items.answer: Yes. The Business plan and bespoke projects support custom functionality, integrations, automation and AI, depending on requirements.

items.question: Do you handle hosting and publishing?
items.answer: We include deployment and initial setup. Hosting can be handled by Artecium or the client, depending on the agreed solution for each project.

items.question: Can I request changes after launch?
items.answer: Yes. Changes and ongoing maintenance can be agreed after launch, depending on the support or evolution plan defined for the project.

items.question: What is SEO?
items.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the set of practices aimed at improving a website's visibility in organic search results, through technical optimisation, content, structure and authority.

items.question: How much does SEO cost?
items.answer: SEO Foundation costs €350 as a one-time payment. SEO Growth costs €500 per month and SEO Advanced costs €900 per month. Final scope may vary depending on the website and requirements.

items.question: What's the difference between SEO Foundation, Growth and Advanced?
items.answer: SEO Foundation is an initial setup with a technical base. SEO Growth includes ongoing optimisation, research and monthly reporting. SEO Advanced adds a more complete strategy, competitor analysis, GEO/AI Search and strategic support.

items.question: How long does SEO take to produce results?
items.answer: SEO is an ongoing process. Results vary depending on market, competition, current website state, content, authority and other factors. Specific timelines cannot be guaranteed.

items.question: Can you guarantee first position on Google?
items.answer: No. No agency can legitimately guarantee a specific position in Google's organic results.

items.question: What is GEO?
items.answer: GEO, or Generative Engine Optimization, refers to optimising content and structure to improve how information can be understood and used by search and AI systems.

items.question: Does SEO help with AI-powered search engines?
items.answer: Good content structure, technical SEO and clear information can help information be better understood. However, there is no guarantee of appearing in AI-generated answers or AI Overviews.

items.question: Is it necessary to publish content regularly?
items.answer: It depends on the strategy and market. Some projects benefit from regular content; in others, the priority may be optimising existing pages. We define the approach based on goals.

items.question: Can you work on SEO for a website built by another company?
items.answer: Yes. We can audit and optimise existing websites, provided we have the necessary access to the tools and platforms involved.

items.question: Do you handle local SEO?
items.answer: Yes. Local SEO can be included in Growth and Advanced plans, depending on the business's geographic goals.

hero.title: How much does a website cost in Portugal in 2026?
hero.intro: If you're planning a website for your business, the first question is almost always the same: how much does it cost? The honest answer is that it depends on the type of project, design, features, and what you need after launch. In this guide we explain what drives pricing, how to compare proposals, and how much to invest in a professional website in Portugal — including Artecium's actual prices.

averageCost.title: How much does a website cost on average in Portugal?
averageCost.paragraph: There is no single price for every website. The final cost depends mainly on project scope and what needs to work day to day. Two sites with the same number of pages can cost very different amounts if one includes advanced forms, integrations, or a client area.

priceTable.title: Pricing by project type
priceTable.disclaimer: The categories below describe common project types. They are not fixed market prices — every quote depends on scope, features, and provider. When we mention Artecium prices, we state that explicitly.

rows.includes: One page focused on a single goal: presentation, campaign, or lead capture.
rows.note: Ideal for validating an offer or promoting a specific service. Price increases with custom design, copywriting, and integrations.

rows.includes: Core pages (home, services, about, contact), clear structure, and a contact form.
rows.note: The most common option for businesses that need a professional online presence without complex features.

rows.includes: More pages, stronger content structure, basic SEO, forms, and possibly a blog or dedicated sections.
rows.note: Suited for businesses that want to generate leads and build credibility. At Artecium, the Professional plan starts at €1,500.

rows.includes: Integrations, automation, client areas, multilingual setup, or custom workflows.
rows.note: Price reflects technical complexity. Artecium Business projects start at €2,500.

rows.includes: A system with login, dashboards, internal processes, or business logic — not just an informational site.
rows.note: Requires individual scoping. At Artecium, web applications start at €3,500.

priceFactors.title: What influences the price of a website?

items.title: Number of pages and content
items.description: More pages mean more design, copy, reviews, and implementation time. A well-structured five-page site is often more efficient than ten poorly planned pages.

items.title: Design and visual identity
items.description: Custom design aligned with your brand requires more work than adapting a template. Logo, typography, imagery, and visual consistency all affect the budget.

items.title: Features and integrations
items.description: Advanced forms, bookings, payments, CRM, newsletters, or connections to existing systems increase development complexity and cost.

items.title: SEO and performance
items.description: A technically solid, fast website prepared for search engines requires additional setup. Ongoing SEO is usually contracted separately.

items.title: Automation and AI
items.description: Chatbots, automated contact flows, or AI tool integrations can reduce manual work but require configuration and testing.

items.title: Maintenance and evolution
items.description: After launch, you may need content updates, fixes, or new features. This can be agreed as one-off support or an ongoing plan.

institutional.title: How much does a corporate website cost?
paragraphs: A corporate website presents your company, services, and contact options. It is the foundation of online presence for most businesses in Portugal — from consultants and clinics to local service companies.
It typically includes pages such as Home, Services, About, and Contact, with professional design, a contact form, and a structure that works well on mobile and desktop.
At Artecium, this type of project often fits the Essential plan (€750) when the scope is straightforward and focused on a solid presence without advanced features.

professional.title: How much does a professional website cost?
paragraphs: A professional website goes beyond basic presence: a more complete content structure, dedicated service sections, better SEO preparation, and more focus on converting visitors into leads.
It may include a blog, FAQ, campaign landing pages, or simple marketing tool integrations.
At Artecium, the Professional plan (€1,500) reflects this level of depth — ideal for businesses that want to grow online, not just "be on the internet".

webApp.title: How much does a web application cost?
paragraphs: A web application is not a traditional website. It involves business logic, authentication, dashboards, internal workflows, or ongoing user interaction — for example, client areas, order management, or internal tools.
Pricing almost always depends on functional requirements, integrations, security, and usage volume. Web applications are therefore quoted individually.

At Artecium, web applications start at €3,500. If your project combines a public website with advanced features, it is worth assessing whether you need an expanded professional site or a dedicated application.

domainHosting.title: Are domain and hosting included?
paragraphs: At Artecium, we include deployment and initial website configuration. The domain (for example, your .pt or .com name) is usually registered in the client's name or managed together, depending on the agreement.

Hosting can be handled by Artecium or by the client, depending on the solution agreed for each project. In some cases, the client already has hosting; in others, we recommend infrastructure suited to the type of site.
The important point is to clarify these items in the proposal — domain, hosting, email, and renewals should not be assumed as included without explicit confirmation.

maintenance.title: Do you have to pay maintenance every month?
paragraphs: Not every website requires mandatory monthly maintenance. After launch, many businesses only need occasional updates — new text, images, or small changes.
However, websites with significant traffic, integrations, or ongoing security needs benefit from regular support: technical updates, backups, monitoring, and improvements.

At Artecium, changes and ongoing maintenance can be agreed after launch, according to the support or evolution plan defined for the project. There is no single fixed amount — it depends on what the site needs over time.

seoPricing.title: How much does SEO cost?
seoPricing.intro: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) helps your website get found on Google and other search engines. At Artecium, SEO is offered in distinct plans depending on the level of support:

plans.name: SEO Foundation
plans.description: Initial technical setup: structure, metadata, indexing, and a solid base for organic growth.

plans.name: SEO Growth
plans.description: Ongoing optimization, keyword research, content work, and monthly reporting.

plans.name: SEO Advanced
plans.description: More complete strategy, competitor analysis, GEO/AI Search, and strategic follow-up.

arteciumPricing.title: How much does a website cost at Artecium?
arteciumPricing.intro: The prices below are Artecium's current commercial website plans. Each project is confirmed after understanding scope, features, and business goals.

plans.name: Essential
plans.description: Essential professional website for businesses that need a solid, clear online presence.

plans.name: Professional
plans.description: More content depth, structure, and preparation for growth and conversion.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: Projects with advanced features, integrations, or specific business requirements.

items.question: How much does a website cost for a small business?
items.answer: For many small businesses, a well-built corporate or professional website is enough. At Artecium, websites start at €750 (Essential). If you need more pages, SEO, or features, the Professional plan (€1,500) or Business (from €2,500) may be a better fit.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: It depends on complexity and how quickly content (copy, images, approvals) is delivered. An essential website can be ready in a few weeks; projects with more features or integrations take longer. The exact timeline is defined in the proposal.

items.question: Does the price include SEO?
items.answer: Website plans include basic technical best practices (structure, performance, essential metadata). Ongoing SEO — research, optimized content, and monitoring — is a separate service, from €350 (SEO Foundation) or on monthly plans.

items.question: Do I need to pay for hosting?
items.answer: Hosting can be handled by Artecium or by the client, depending on the agreement. We include deployment and initial setup; hosting and domain should be confirmed in the proposal to avoid surprises.

items.question: Can I request just a landing page?
items.answer: Yes. If the goal is to promote a campaign, service, or specific offer, a landing page may be the right solution. Price depends on design, copy, and required integrations.

items.question: Can I add features later?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients start with an essential website and evolve later — blog, SEO, automation, client area, or integrations. Artecium can plan that evolution from the start or implement it in a later phase.

items.question: How much does a web application cost?
items.answer: Web applications are quoted individually because they involve business logic, authentication, and specific technical requirements. At Artecium, they start at €3,500.
